title: Ablate FOMO Radar provenance, convergence and exit mechanisms against Memes v3 baseline
objective: Implement only the minimum Alpha Lab variants needed to test whether receipt-level trade provenance, recipient-spoof rejection, adaptive dust/seed quarantine, first-buy convergence and cohort-exit state add incremental prospective value over the existing Memes v3 baseline. Preserve entity-before-wallet, strict as-of-time evidence, executable returns and Cycle Navigator regime context. Do not fork the external application, import its global wallet score as authority, or create a parallel signal/execution engine.

scope: add a deterministic TRADE_PROVENANCE_GATE after address-role resolution and before wallet skill/convergence consumption
classify intentional trade, recipient-spoof/gifted swap, dust/probe, passive transfer, service/router/protocol flow and unresolved with fail-closed promotion semantics
preserve receipt evidence and immutable provenance fields so later rule changes can replay old fills without rewriting raw evidence
add positive and negative fixtures for spoofed recipient flow, seeded multi-wallet flow and genuine wallet buys
ensure quote assets and service/inventory addresses cannot inflate wallet convergence
implement first-buy convergence as an ablation using strict score-as-of-time evidence only
compare raw wallet convergence against independent-entity convergence after funder/controller clustering
persist condition_time, observed_at, computed_at, alert_delivery_time and first_executable_time separately when available
extend First Distribution Survival with cohort-exit acceleration, fraction of original independent conviction exited, genuine sell vs transfer/migration and new-buyer absorption
bind Cycle Navigator regime state as evaluation context rather than letting a burst threshold be universal
run ablations for no dust filter vs absolute floor vs wallet-relative/adaptive rules and report false-positive/false-negative tradeoffs
test seeded-token quarantine under adversarial cases without letting a small attacker hide genuine broad demand
compare external-style global wallet scoring with Conditional Wallet Intelligence and outlier-ablation
replay FLYBRAIN with replay condition time separated from actual historical detection/delivery/execution time
reconstruct an exit-consensus case such as CRUMBS only if exact identity and chain history can be reproduced

positive: A recipient-spoof fixture cannot count toward wallet conviction or multi-wallet convergence.
A genuine wallet buy remains a genuine buy after provenance verification.
Raw immutable receipt evidence survives changes to dust/seed classification rules and can be replayed deterministically.
A multi-wallet alert reports both raw wallet count and independent-entity count; linked wallets cannot silently count as independent confirmations.
Historical replay uses the wallet score/evidence available at that historical moment for promotion-grade evaluation.
Condition time, system observation time, alert delivery time and first executable time cannot be conflated.
Exit state distinguishes a trim from broad cohort departure and excludes unknown pre-tape cost/position states where required.
Every performance table includes sample count, matched baseline, regime context, executable-return assumptions and downside/path metrics.
The candidate can reject an external mechanism if it fails incremental-value ablation.
negative: No current/global wallet score may be applied backward to historical trades as promotion evidence.
No raw wallet headcount, global 0-100 score, Fomo headline PnL, 2x-hit rate or model identity may independently produce QUALIFIED_ALPHA.
No fixed external dust threshold or burst threshold becomes canonical by copying the external repository.
No external repository code is vendored wholesale into the Framework without a separate license/security/design review.
No automatic trading, copy trading, BUY/SELL/size output, new portfolio authority or new independent scheduler is authorized.
No paid provider, API-budget increase or secret-bearing source is authorized by this candidate.

forbidden_changes: global wallet score as canonical authority
